questions.explanation: AND is TRUE only when both inputs are TRUE: only the last row.
OR is FALSE only when both inputs are FALSE: only the first row.

questions.prompt: NOT comes first: fill in NOT A AND B.
questions.explanation: NOT applies to A alone, then AND: TRUE only when A is FALSE and B is TRUE.

questions.prompt: The press may run only if both hands are on their buttons and the guard is closed. How are the contacts LeftHand, RightHand and Guard wired in the rung?
options: All three in series, one after the other
All three in parallel, side by side
LeftHand and RightHand in parallel, then Guard in series
All three as normally closed contacts
questions.explanation: Every condition must be TRUE, so this is AND: LeftHand AND RightHand AND Guard. AND is contacts in series.

questions.prompt: A rung has a **normally closed** contact of the tag TankFull. When does that contact pass power?
questions.explanation: A normally closed contact is NOT: it passes power while its tag is FALSE, here while the tank is not full.
